questions: Do the original island-mean and source-site levels support beetle spatial Simpson homogenization and its 18/18 source half-split sign stability, without implying seven universally homogenizing islands?
Can increased local beetle richness coexist with observed island spatial beta homogenization within some original source islands?
How often do arthropod guilds have opposite island spatial beta direction? Do Simpson replacement and Sorensen total dissimilarity ever disagree?
Is the canopy-beating Beetle score kept STOP and can sampling-method differences qualify the Spider inference?

calculations.primary: Strictly source-free mean over seven original per-island B3-minus-B1 spatial Simpson and Sorensen values; assert exact identity to v1.318 frozen run.
calculations.richness_test: For each island×guild, compare B3 vs B1 originally observed mean local richness among the identical physical site set; count homogenization (delta Simpson <0) AND richness increase (B3 mean > B1 mean), without claiming island mechanism.
calculations.gamma_test: Report B3 minus B1 island-level detected pooled guild taxon counts only as descriptive backdrop, not as partition/cause or island-wide true gamma richness.
calculations.metric_discordance: Count islands where sign(Simpson spatial delta) differs from sign(Sorensen spatial delta) within original guild.
calculations.guild_discordance: Count island codes with opposite sign spatial Simpson deltas between spiders and beetles; paired island contexts, not independent taxon tests.
calculations.split_stability: Only source v1.318 fixed 9 salts ×2 complementary half-sampling direction counts; no new Event reads, no new partitions, no new significance thresholds.
calculations.canopy: Respect already frozen Spider canopy source direction and Beetle canopy STOP; do not interpret canopy vs pitfall as randomized forest structure experiment

evidence_class: Retrospective descriptive site- and source-guild-aggregate arithmetic, NOT new biological data, not an independent replication, not a causal mechanism.
stop_conditions: Original BALA source ZIP SHA, v1.318 source result JSON SHA or original 29 source physical transects differ
Seven source islands, original 29/28 guild sites or original 56/49 dependent source pairs change
Any per-island spatial beta delta fails B3-B1 original arithmetic or seven-island mean
Original 18 source half-splits, required 7/7 island output, earlier canopy Beetle STOP or GEB scientific HOLD are modified
nonclaims: Spatial beta change due only to richness, corrected detection, or a universal guild response
